About me

I'm Syed Siam Ul Kabir, an educator currently pursuing my Master's in Education (M.Ed.) in Science, Mathematics and Technology Education (SMTE) at the Institute of Education and Research (IER), University of Dhaka, having completed my B.Ed. (Honours) in the same department.

My identity as an educator is shaped by both rigorous academic preparation and real classroom practice. During a six-month internship at Nilkhet High School, I taught Science — Chemistry and Biology — to secondary students (classes 6–10), designed lesson plans, managed classrooms, and supported co-curricular activities with fellow intern teachers.

Alongside formal schooling, I have worked as a private tutor with Caretutors and completed university coursework in computer applications and basic programming. These experiences strengthen my ability to plan, assess, and bring practical digital skills into STEM teaching.
